originalTitle: Is 'Trumpflation' real? Why Wall Street fears this could be a reason for stock market crash
simplifiedContent: There's a concern on Wall Street that something called "Trumpflation" could cause the stock market to crash. This worry is growing because of rising prices, which are increasing at a rate of 3.3%, and higher interest rates on government loans. The Federal Reserve, which controls interest rates, might keep rates high or even increase them, which could affect the value of stocks. This matters because higher interest rates can make it more expensive for companies to borrow money, which could hurt their stock prices. As a result, the high values of stocks on Wall Street might not be sustainable.

originalTitle: World Bank's IFC, HDFC AMC invest in Molbio Diagnostics' Rs 281 crore IPO anchor round
simplifiedContent: Molbio Diagnostics, a company based in Goa, is planning to raise money by selling shares to the public through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Before the IPO opens on August 10, the company has already raised Rs 281 crore from some big investors, including the World Bank's IFC and HDFC Mutual Fund. This is called an "anchor round" and it's a sign that these investors believe in the company's potential. The company also sold some existing shares worth Rs 160 crore to other investors. Major brokerages think this is a good investment opportunity and are recommending that people buy shares in the IPO.

originalTitle: Market Trading Guide: Jindal Saw among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: Some companies in India have recently shared their financial results, and most of them have done as well as or better than expected. This is making investors feel more positive about certain areas of the market. As a result, some experts are recommending that investors consider buying shares of specific companies, including Jindal Saw, on Monday. This could be a good opportunity for investors to make some money. The positive earnings reports are supporting optimism in the market, which means investors are feeling more hopeful about the future.

originalTitle: The stock market is finally rising again—and it’s getting cheaper, too
simplifiedContent: The stock market, which is measured by something called the S&P 500, has been doing well and has gone up by 22% in the last year. Even though the market is rising, the valuations, or how much people are willing to pay for stocks, have actually decreased. This means that stocks are becoming cheaper, which could be a good thing for people who want to invest. The fact that the market is going up and valuations are coming down is a positive sign for investors. This matters because it could be a good time for people to consider investing in the stock market.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: There are some new companies that will be selling their shares to the public for the first time, called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Two of these companies are Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, and their IPOs will open next week, between August 10 and 12. This means that people can buy shares of these companies during this time. At the same time, shares of eight other companies that started selling last week will start trading on the market. This is important because it gives investors new opportunities to buy shares of these companies and potentially make money.

originalTitle: Defence stock Apollo Micro Systems declares Q1 results 2026. Revenue jumps 88% YoY to  ₹251 crore, PAT up 43%
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defense industry, just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company's revenue, which is the total amount of money it made from sales, increased by 88% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹251 crore. Its net profit, which is the amount of money the company has left after paying all its expenses, also increased by 43% to ₹25.2 crore. This is a significant increase and suggests that the company is performing well. This matters because it can affect the company's stock price and influence investment decisions, making it important for investors to pay attention to these results.
